gap_records.claim: Iteration-2 priority 2 / acceptance gate: a persisted late-round liveness record (a health or player-transform read well after the short E3 battery window) must exist under .hoh/deterministic/raw/.
gap_records.player_impact: Nothing directly player-visible; the process liveness after the early battery window is asserted only by non-persisted calls, so a mid-round crash or freeze would not be citable from the frozen records.
gap_records.recommended_update: Have the deterministic battery write one extra record into .hoh/deterministic/raw/ several seconds after the E3 steps: a bevy_health read plus a bevy_player_transform read whose frame field comes from hof_game::contract::FrameCounter, and cite it as the liveness step.

gap_records.claim: Acceptance gate sub-condition: WinFlag.won must be read true at a frame whose player transform x equals the goal's reachable x. The frozen contract exposes no reflected goal entity or goal x, so this equality cannot be checked from any observable.
gap_records.player_impact: The win could in principle be triggered at a position other than the visually intended goal and a player would still see 'won', so the win position is not independently confirmed (the false->true transition itself is confirmed under P3).
gap_records.recommended_update: Either register the goal marker/x as a reflected contract component (a frozen type-path change requiring a decision) or state in the plan's acceptance gate that the goal position is not part of the observable contract and drop the equality check.

preservation_constraints: Do not rename or re-register any frozen contract type path: crate hof_game, module hof_game::contract, types Player, Grounded, FrameCounter, CoinCounter, WinFlag, InputIntent, Velocity, Transform.
Keep RemotePlugin::default() + RemoteHttpPlugin::default() + ScheduleRunnerPlugin with the headless switch so 127.0.0.1:15702 stays bound and the app does not exit after one frame.
Keep InputIntent level-triggered with the game clearing it each frame, and keep every reading's frame field sourced from FrameCounter, never a poll ordinal.

Keep the verified iteration-2 behaviour as the regression baseline: dir=1 raises x, dir=-1 lowers x, dir=0 freezes x byte-identically; coins 0 -> 1 -> 2 monotone with target 2; won false -> true one-way; the jump arc rises then falls and returns to ground with Grounded true before take-off and false mid-flight.
update_targets: Add a persisted late-round liveness record under .hoh/deterministic/raw/ (gap S1): a bevy_health plus bevy_player_transform read some seconds after the E3 steps, with a FrameCounter-derived frame field.

Resolve the goal-position observability question (gap P3-goal-x): either expose the goal x as a reflected contract value or explicitly drop the 'player x equals the goal's reachable x' acceptance sub-condition.
validation_requirements: Re-run the deterministic battery and require ok=true for e3_movement, e3_movement_left, e3_movement_release, e3_jump_arc, e3_grounded, e3_grounded_payload, e3_coin_counter, e3_win_flag, e3_win_position.
Require CoinCounter.coins to read 0 before any pickup, 1 after the first coin and exactly 2 after the second, monotone non-decreasing across every later read in the session.
Require WinFlag.won false -> true and true for all subsequent reads in the same session.
Require the jump arc to contain both rising and falling samples and end back at the on-ground y, with Grounded.on_ground true before take-off and false mid-flight.
Require a persisted liveness record under .hoh/deterministic/raw/ that answers several seconds after the E3 battery.
